title: PhotoScout plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: The plugin.json at the root of a PhotoScout plugin package. Mirrors parseManifest in server/src/plugins/manifest.ts. Where the host is more lenient than this schema, docs/plugins/authoring.md section 'Schema vs host' lists the difference. scripts/plugin.mjs also runs the host's own parseManifest, so the host's rules always apply.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint. The host ignores it.

description.description: One sentence on what the plugin does. Shown in the admin list.

homepage.description: Optional URL for the plugin's page, shown to the admin.

icon.description: Optional image inside the package (served with the web bundle).

category.description: Where the plugin belongs in the admin list.

photoscout.description: Semver range of the host plugin API this plugin was built for, e.g. ^1.0. The host's API version is 1.0.0 today.

server.description: Server entry: a self-contained ES module at the package root. Its default export is definePlugin({ activate }). Optional.

web.description: Web bundle: a self-contained ES module at the package root. Its default export is { activate(host) }. Optional.

permissions.description: What the plugin says it needs. Shown to the admin; not enforced by the browser.

services.description: Named external services. The admin sets each one's URL; see authoring.md.

settings.description: Fields the admin fills in on the plugin's settings page.

public.description: Routes under /api/plugins/<id>/ that a visitor who has not signed in may GET or HEAD. Every other plugin route needs a signed-in session.

pluginId.description: Reverse-DNS: at least two dot-separated parts, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Example: media.example.waze

version.description: Plain semver: 1.2.3 or 1.2.3-beta.1. No leading v, no build metadata (+build).

packagePath.description: A path inside the package: relative, forward slashes, no .. segments, no empty segments.

jsFile.description: A package path ending in .js (the host does not accept .mjs for manifest entries).

publicRoute.description: A path under the plugin, starting with /. Letters, digits and . _ ~ : - / only; * matches any run of characters (slashes included), at most 4 per pattern. Examples: /places, /stations/*

detail.description: What the permission is for, e.g. the host it calls. For kind "network" it must be a host or host:port (no scheme or path); that exact host is then reachable from ctx.fetch even if private.

settingKey.description: A letter, then letters, digits or underscores. Object property names are reserved.

default.description: Must be the value of one of the options (checked by the CLI).
